pois.label: 中控屏:三条路选一条(为什么是甲醇制烯烃)
pois.label_en: Control screen: three routes, one chosen (why MTO)
pois.detail: 屏上六个色块就是全线的化学:青 CO₂ 从大气来,橙红 H₂ 从井水来,琥珀甲醇是中间站,紫是烯烃,乳白是聚乙烯,白色的氧从出厂管走。这座城没有塑料——村衬里、家电壳、打印丝材都指望进口包装。三条路都能把 CO₂ 与 H₂ 变成乙烯:铁基费托、甲醇制烯烃、甲烷氧化偶联。选了中间那条,不是因为它最便宜,是因为另外两条在「副产记零」的口径下都撞上了铸造厂的 298 kWh/kg 门槛,而它没有。
pois.detail_en: The six colour blocks on the screen are the whole chemistry: teal CO2 from the atmosphere, orange-red H2 from well water, amber methanol as the halfway station, violet olefins, cream polyethylene, and white oxygen leaving by the export line. This city has no plastic: the village liner, appliance housings and print filament all lean on imported packaging. Three routes turn CO2 and H2 into ethylene - iron Fischer-Tropsch, methanol-to-olefins, oxidative coupling of methane. The middle one was chosen not because it is cheapest but because, with co-products credited at zero, the other two hit the foundry's 298 kWh/kg make-or-import threshold and it does not.

All three route energy bands missed too, because the pre-registration never fixed whether co-products are credited: the two bases differ 5x. Every energy figure now carries its basis.
pois.physics: 同一个原子经济学在三条路上给出同一个净反应 CO₂ + H₂O → −CH₂− + 1.5 O₂,焓变 649 kJ/mol 与路线无关——路线之间差的只有选择性和循环:每一个没变成乙烯的碳都带着它的氢一起走,而氢是这座城里要用井水和电买来的东西。
pois.physics_en: Atom economy gives all three routes the same net reaction, CO2 + H2O -> -CH2- + 1.5 O2, 649 kJ/mol regardless of path. What differs between routes is only selectivity and recycle: every carbon that does not become ethylene leaves with its hydrogen, and hydrogen is the thing this city buys with well water and electricity.

pois.label: 合成气撬:SOXE 造 CO + 水电解造 H₂(氢是井水)
pois.label_en: Syngas skid: SOXE makes CO, electrolysis makes H2 (the hydrogen is well water)
pois.detail: 左边白色岩棉箱里是 800 °C 的固体氧化物电解堆——MOXIE 的血统,ECLSS 那两台 SOXE 的小一号——把大气 CO₂ 拆成 CO 与氧。右边蓝白撬块是水电解,橙红罐出氢、白罐出氧。这两台设备决定了全线的电价:每公斤聚乙烯的电,四分之三花在这里。真正稀缺的不是电(城网 176 MW),是水:每公斤 PE 净耗井水 1.28 升,丙烯没去向时 3.03 升。
pois.detail_en: Inside the white rock-wool box on the left is an 800 C solid-oxide electrolysis stack - MOXIE lineage, one size down from the two SOXE units at the ECLSS plant - splitting atmospheric CO2 into CO and oxygen. The blue-and-white skid on the right is water electrolysis: hydrogen out of the orange-red drum, oxygen out of the white one. These two machines set the whole line's electricity price: three quarters of the electricity in a kilogram of polyethylene is spent here. What is scarce is not electricity (the grid has 176 MW) but water: 1.28 litres of well water net per kilogram of PE, 3.03 litres when the propylene has nowhere to go.

pois.physics: 稳态循环里没有免费的水:甲醇合成和 MTO 吐出来的每一摩尔水都要回到电解槽再拆一次,所以电解槽的通量是 2 H₂ 每碳,净消耗才是 1——电按通量付,水按净消耗付。这就是为什么电的账是 23 而水的账是 1.28:同一个氢,两本账。
pois.physics_en: There is no free water in a steady-state loop: every mole of water that methanol synthesis and MTO release goes back to the electrolyser to be split again, so the electrolyser's throughput is 2 H2 per carbon while the net consumption is 1 - electricity is paid on throughput, water on net consumption. That is why the electricity account reads 23 and the water account 1.28: the same hydrogen, two ledgers.

pois.label: 甲醇塔:20 bar 的球铁塔(为什么不是 50 bar)
pois.label_en: Methanol converter: a ductile-iron tower at 20 bar (why not 50)
pois.detail: 剖开的塔里那五根墨绿色管束是 Cu/ZnO/Al₂O₃ 催化剂——铜和锌是进口的,一个会合窗口 19 公斤。地球上的甲醇塔跑 50–80 bar;这一座跑 20 bar,单程转化只有 22%(50 bar 是 53%),多循环一倍多。换来的是壳体能用铸造厂的球铁铸(球铁压力件的声明上限 24 bar / 343 °C),不用进口 Cr-Mo 钢。塔旁那只琥珀色小罐是全场唯一的甲醇存量,不超过一 sol 的料——甲醇有毒,而且它站在舱外。
pois.detail_en: The five dark-green tubes inside the cut-open tower are Cu/ZnO/Al2O3 catalyst - the copper and zinc are imported, 19 kg per rendezvous window. Methanol converters on Earth run at 50-80 bar; this one runs at 20, where single-pass conversion is only 22 % (53 % at 50 bar) and the recycle more than doubles. What that buys is a shell the foundry can cast in ductile iron (declared pressure-part limits 24 bar / 343 C) instead of importing Cr-Mo steel. The small amber drum beside it is the only methanol inventory on site, under one sol of feed - methanol is toxic, and it stands outside.

sim_en: [r1 2026-09-13] Account 1 G1.3: the constant-dCp van't Hoff lands inside the JANAF band at all three points (298 / 500 / 600 K); G1.4 degenerate gates: conversion -> 0 as P -> 0 and -> 1 as K -> infinity. The equilibrium is ideal-gas (declared); no fugacity correction at 50 bar, so the 22 % at 20 bar errs on the conservative side.

[r1 2026-09-13] Account 5: the methanol converter is the only one of 24 items whose make-or-import verdict hangs on a single number from account 1: 22 % at 20 bar >= the 15 % rule -> ductile iron, local. At 50 bar it would be a 1.5 t imported steel shell; what is saved is not money but one crate in a rendezvous window.
pois.physics: 勒沙特列在这里是一张采购单:合成气变甲醇是三摩尔变一摩尔的反应,压力越高平衡越靠右,所以地球把它压到 50 bar。在火星,压力容器的钢是要发射的,球铁是能铸的——把压力降到 24 bar 以下,是用循环压缩机的电换掉一船钢。
pois.physics_en: Le Chatelier here is a procurement list: syngas to methanol turns three moles into one, so higher pressure pushes the equilibrium right and Earth runs it at 50 bar. On Mars pressure-vessel steel has to be launched while ductile iron can be cast - dropping below 24 bar trades a recycle compressor's electricity for a ship's worth of steel.

pois.label: MTO 流化床:450 °C 的铸石衬里(乙烯 42%,丙烯 38%)
pois.label_en: MTO fluidised bed: a cast-stone-lined shell at 450 C (ethylene 42 %, propylene 38 %)
pois.detail: 全线的心脏,朝观察侧剖开:里面橙红发亮的是 450 °C 的 SAPO-34 催化剂流化床,甲醇蒸气进去,出来的是乙烯和丙烯各四成、丁烯一成、外加 CH₄、焦和一点重质。壳是铸造厂的铁,里面那层深色的是玻璃厂的铸石衬里加岩棉——把铁壳压到 300 °C 以下,球铁才扛得住,这是玻璃厂熔窑墙的同一招。旁边细一点的塔是再生器:焦烧掉,CO₂ 回进气塔,催化剂沿两根浅褐色立管循环。
pois.detail_en: The heart of the line, cut open toward the viewer: the glowing orange-red mass is the SAPO-34 catalyst bed at 450 C. Methanol vapour goes in; out come ethylene and propylene at roughly 40 % each, butenes at 10 %, plus methane, coke and a little heavies. The shell is foundry iron; the dark inner layer is cast stone from the glass plant with rock wool behind it, holding the iron below 300 C where ductile iron can serve - the glass plant's own furnace-wall trick. The thinner tower beside it is the regenerator: the coke is burnt off, the CO2 goes back to the intake, and catalyst circulates through the two tan standpipes.

pois.physics: SAPO-34 的孔口只有 0.38 nm,乙烯和丙烯挤得出去,丁烯以上出不去——这就是它选择性的来源,一个分子筛的几何,不是一个催化剂的化学。而同一个孔道也把芳烃困在笼里变成焦,所以再生器不是可选件:每一克乙烯都伴着一个烧焦的循环。
pois.physics_en: SAPO-34's pore mouths are 0.38 nm: ethylene and propylene squeeze out, butenes and larger do not - the selectivity comes from a molecular sieve's geometry, not a catalyst's chemistry. The same cages trap aromatics until they become coke, so the regenerator is not optional: every gram of ethylene comes with a coke-burning cycle.

pois.label: 冷箱:−100 °C 的三座塔(进口件里最重的一件)
pois.label_en: Cold box: three columns at -100 C (the heaviest import on site)
pois.detail: 白色岩棉箱里立着三座钢塔:脱甲烷塔、脱乙烷塔、乙烯/乙烷分离塔,逐级降到 −100 °C,把 MTO 出来的混合烯烃分成聚合级乙烯(要 99.9%,CO 低于 1 ppm——聚合催化剂对这些毒物按 ppm 计)。球铁在 −20 °C 以下不评级,所以这三座塔连同旁边的级联制冷压缩机是全线最重的进口件,3.5 吨。城里唯一另一台制冷机在 200 多米外的低温罐区,没有管过来。丙烯从侧面那根紫管出去,去向还没定。
pois.detail_en: Three steel columns stand inside the white rock-wool box: demethaniser, deethaniser, ethylene/ethane splitter, stepping down to -100 C to turn the MTO's mixed olefins into polymer-grade ethylene (99.9 %, CO below 1 ppm - the polymerisation catalyst counts these poisons in ppm). Ductile iron is not rated below -20 C, so these columns and the cascade refrigeration compressors beside them are the line's heaviest import at 3.5 tonnes. The only other refrigerator in the city is 200-odd metres away at the cryogenic farm, with no pipe between. Propylene leaves by the violet side line, destination still open.

pois.physics_en: Ethylene and ethane have a relative volatility of only about 1.5; separating them takes a column of a hundred-odd trays at -30 C - the cost of separation is never the cold but the likeness of two molecules. Mars does not help: 600 Pa suppresses convection but not conduction, so the cold box still needs vacuum or rock wool, the same physics as the cryogenic farm's '6 mbar is no substitute for a vacuum jacket'.

pois.label: 气相聚合釜:20 bar/90 °C 的球铁釜(乙烯变成粉)
pois.label_en: Gas-phase polymerisation reactor: a ductile-iron vessel at 20 bar / 90 C (ethylene becomes powder)
pois.detail: 剖开的釜里那段白色的就是产品:流化的 HDPE 粉,乙烯在催化剂颗粒上长成链。釜是 20 bar、90 °C——正好落在球铁的限内,所以壳体是铸造厂的;催化剂用 Ziegler–Natta(钛来自铸造厂的 FFC 槽,镁来自皮江炉,氯来自玻璃厂的酸循环,只有烷基铝进口)或 Phillips 铬/硅(硅胶载体是玻璃厂的白料,铬按克计进口)。釜顶那截粗的是沉降段,循环气经卧式冷却器和后面的压缩机回到釜底——聚合每公斤放热 3.3 兆焦,全靠这条循环带走。
pois.detail_en: The white mass in the cut-open reactor is the product: fluidised HDPE powder, ethylene growing into chains on catalyst grains. The vessel runs at 20 bar and 90 C - inside the ductile-iron limits, so the shell is the foundry's. The catalyst is Ziegler-Natta (titanium from the foundry's FFC cell, magnesium from its Pidgeon furnace, chlorine from the glass plant's acid loop, only the aluminium alkyl imported) or Phillips chromium-on-silica (the silica carrier is the glass plant's white feed, chromium imported by the gram). The wider top section is the disengagement zone; cycle gas runs through the horizontal cooler and the compressor behind it back into the base - polymerisation releases 3.3 MJ per kilogram, all of it carried off by that loop.

pois.physics: 聚合是把双键的 π 电子换成两条 σ 键,每接一个单体放 90 多千焦——同一台釜若不把热带走,粉会在几分钟内熔成一块。气相釜的循环气就是它的冷却水,压缩机是它的心脏:这台设备的安全不在压力壳,在压缩机不许停。
pois.physics_en: Polymerisation swaps a double bond's pi electrons for two sigma bonds and releases ninety-odd kilojoules per monomer added - left uncooled, the powder in this vessel would fuse into a block within minutes. The cycle gas is the reactor's cooling water and the compressor its heart: the safety of this machine lies not in the pressure shell but in the compressor never stopping.

pois.label_en: Extrusion, pelletising and silos: pellets leave here (a 50 kg/sol campaign line)
pois.detail: 脱气仓用 CO₂ 吹掉粉里残留的乙烯——氮气一公斤 5.27 千瓦时,CO₂ 只要 0.15,便宜 35 倍,而且它是大气。造粒棚里挤出机的机筒是铸造厂车的,螺杆和切粒刀进口;水下切粒后气力输送到两只打印土料仓。铭牌 50 公斤一 sol,是井压出来的数;稳态需求(丝材上界 16 公斤)远小于它,所以这是一条战役制的线:接到衬里那种一次性大单就开,平时停——与玻璃厂透明线同形。
pois.detail_en: The degassing bin purges residual ethylene from the powder with CO2 - nitrogen costs 5.27 kWh a kilogram here, CO2 0.15, 35 times cheaper, and it is the atmosphere. In the pelletising shed the extruder barrel was turned at the foundry; the screw and cutter knives are imported. After underwater pelletising the product is conveyed pneumatically to two printed-regolith silos. The 50 kg/sol nameplate is the number the well allows; steady demand (filament, 16 kg/sol at most) is far below it, so this is a campaign line: it runs when a one-off order like the liner comes in and stands idle otherwise - the same shape as the glass plant's clear line.

pois.physics_en: A line's nameplate should be set by its scarcest input, not by demand: here the scarcest input is the hydrogen in the well. Steady demand is a third of the nameplate, so the gap between capacity and demand is not waste but delivery time - the one-off 101 tonnes takes 2.7 rendezvous windows, and that is the number the village should weigh against importing.

pois.label_en: By-products: the city's largest oxygen source, and a violet pipe with no destination yet
pois.detail: 棚后那排黑色的斜板是辐射板场,108 平方米,把甲醇塔、流化床、聚合釜和压缩机的热辐射向天空——舱外 600 Pa 没有对流。白色的出厂管走的是氧:SOXE 放一份、电解放两份,每公斤 PE 净出 3.4 公斤氧,50 kg PE/sol 时全线 400 公斤一 sol,是硫厂 200 的两倍——这条线一开,它就是全城最大的氧源,去向是低温罐区的冷箱或 ISRU 的液氧。旁边那根紫管是丙烯,每公斤乙烯出 0.9 公斤,三个去向都写了,一个没选:选哪个决定井的账。
pois.detail_en: The row of black tilted panels behind the shed is the radiator field, 108 m2, radiating the heat of the methanol converter, the fluidised bed, the polymerisation reactor and the compressors to the sky - at 600 Pa outside there is no convection. The white export line carries oxygen: one part from the SOXE, two from the electrolyser, 3.4 kg net per kg PE, 400 kg/sol for the whole train at 50 kg PE/sol, twice the sulfur plant's 200 - the moment this line runs it is the city's largest oxygen source, bound for the cryogenic farm's cold box or ISRU's LOX. The violet pipe beside it is propylene, 0.9 kg per kg ethylene, with three destinations written and none chosen: the choice sets the well's account.

pois.physics: 把 CO₂ 和水变成塑料,本质上是把它们的氧全部剥下来:聚乙烯里没有一个氧原子。所以每公斤塑料都对应三公斤多的氧——在地球这是要付钱处理的尾气,在火星是可以呼吸、可以装进火箭的产品。同一个反应,行星不同,副产的正负号翻了。
pois.physics_en: Turning CO2 and water into plastic is, at bottom, stripping every oxygen atom off them: there is not one oxygen atom in polyethylene. So each kilogram of plastic stands for three-odd kilograms of oxygen - on Earth a waste gas you pay to handle, on Mars something to breathe or load into a rocket. Same reaction, different planet, and the by-product's sign flips.

pois.label: 控制间:全线唯一的增压体(为什么产线放舱外)
pois.label_en: Control room: the line's only pressurised volume (why the plant lives outside)
pois.detail: 整条线只有这间打印土壳的小屋是加压的,进风口立在朝场外的一侧,离 CO 和甲醇设备三十米以上。理由写在账 4 里:乙烯的最小点火能 0.07 毫焦,是氢的量级;两公斤乙烯就能把村里一段 78 立方米的脊廊填到爆炸下限,而在 30% 氧当量的舱气里,一次爆燃的压力是 70 kPa 壳的 11 倍。舱外正相反:600 Pa 的二氧化碳里氧只有 0.16%,比乙烯的极限氧浓度低 62 倍,淬熄距离 21 厘米——泄漏物理上烧不起来。所以反应器、冷箱、聚合釜、脱气、造粒全部站在防尘棚下,只有粒料进舱。
pois.detail_en: The only pressurised space on the whole line is this small printed-regolith room, its air intake standing on the side facing away from the plant, over thirty metres from the CO and methanol equipment. The reason is in account 4: ethylene's minimum ignition energy is 0.07 mJ, hydrogen's order; two kilograms of it fill a 78 m3 village corridor to the lower flammability limit, and in cabin air at 30 % oxygen-equivalent a deflagration loads the 70 kPa hull eleven times over. Outside it is the reverse: in 600 Pa of CO2 the oxygen is 0.16 %, 62 times below ethylene's limiting oxygen concentration, and the quenching distance is 21 cm - a leak physically cannot burn. So the reactors, cold box, polymerisation, degassing and pelletising all stand under the dust shed, and only pellets enter a cabin.

pois.physics: 同一颗行星把舱内的火变贵、把舱外的火变为不可能——这是消防站那张卡的话,聚合物线是它最极端的应用:一种氢级点火敏感度的气体,放在 600 Pa 的二氧化碳里就是惰性的。所以「安全」在这里不是一套联锁,是一堵墙的位置:乙烯永远在墙的那一边。
pois.physics_en: The same planet makes fire inside a cabin dearer and fire outside impossible - the fire station's card says so, and the polymer line is its most extreme application: a gas with hydrogen-class ignition sensitivity is inert in 600 Pa of carbon dioxide. Safety here is therefore not a set of interlocks but the position of a wall: ethylene is always on the far side of it.

pois.label: 进口件箱:10 吨里装的是什么(造还是运)
pois.label_en: The import crate: what is in the 10 tonnes (make or import)
pois.detail: 这只箱子和旁边的催化剂桶架就是全线要从地球运的东西:两台电解堆、四台压缩机、冷箱的三座钢塔、整流柜、仪表和阀门、挤出螺杆和切粒刀、催化剂——10 吨,占一个会合窗口约 100 吨吞吐的一成。其余 223 吨是本地的:铸造厂的球铁压力壳和铸铁管、玻璃厂的岩棉和铸石衬里、硫厂的混凝土设备基础、打印的料仓和控制间。按铸造厂的规则——300 千瓦时一公斤以内的就该本地做——PE 是 52,余 5.7 倍;而门槛管不到的那一侧照铸造厂的话说:压缩机、催化剂、仪表不是电价问题,是工序链长度问题。
pois.detail_en: This crate and the catalyst drum rack beside it are everything the line has to bring from Earth: two electrolysis stacks, four compressors, the cold box's three steel columns, the rectifier cabinets, instruments and valves, the extruder screw and cutter knives, the catalysts - 10 tonnes, a tenth of a rendezvous window's ~100 t. The other 223 tonnes are local: the foundry's ductile-iron pressure shells and cast-iron pipe, the glass plant's rock wool and cast-stone lining, the sulfur plant's concrete footings, the printed silos and control room. By the foundry's rule - make it locally if it costs under 300 kWh a kilogram - PE at 52 has 5.7x to spare; and on the side the threshold cannot reach, in the foundry's own words: compressors, catalysts and instruments are a process-chain-length problem, not an electricity-price problem.

pois.physics: 一件设备能不能本地造,不看它多重,看它的工序链有多长:一只球铁压力壳只要一炉铁和一个砂型,一台压缩机要轴承钢、绕组铜、密封橡胶和电子——每一样都是这座城还没有的一条线。所以进口清单几乎就是铸造厂那行「0% 本地」的复印件,聚合物线只往上加了三样自己特有的:催化剂、低温钢、电解堆。
pois.physics_en: Whether a piece of equipment can be made locally depends not on its mass but on the length of its process chain: a ductile-iron pressure shell needs one heat of iron and one sand mould, a compressor needs bearing steel, winding copper, seal rubber and electronics - each a line this city does not yet have. So the import list is almost a copy of the foundry's '0 % local' row; the polymer line adds only three items of its own: catalysts, cryogenic steel, electrolysis stacks.
